item.title: macOS Golden Gate 27
item.description:
Must-read for users

If your Mac wasn't upgraded from a macOS 27 beta, the apps you're running may still be older builds from before the official release. Early in the macOS 27 beta some apps failed to launch or had compatibility problems; these have since been fixed and working versions re-uploaded. macOS 27 tightens TCC privacy permission checks. You can use the built-in Console app to view live system logs: search for kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppDataDetailed (or kTCCServiceSystemPolicyAppData if nothing turns up). If the log shows denials for the target app reading a protected directory such as ~/Library/Group Containers/, the app is usually being blocked by TCC privacy restrictions.

item.title: Adobe Activation Tool 1.2.9/2.1.7
item.description:
Activation tool / patch for the Adobe suite

Adobe Activation Tool is a universal activation tool for the Adobe suite on macOS. It supports recent versions of Photoshop, Premiere Pro, Illustrator, After Effects, Acrobat DC, Lightroom Classic, InDesign, the Substance 3D series and more. You just run the program and pick the matching version when prompted. It suits offline environments or users who hit activation limits, and lets people use the full Adobe creative suite without a subscription.

item.title: iStat Menus 7.50.2
item.description:
powerful performance monitoring tool for macOS

the most comprehensive Mac monitoring tool to date, iStat Menus is a full-featured system data collector integrated in your menu bar that provides important information on key metrics. You can get statistics on CPU load, memory load, disk usage/space, disk activity, temperature monitoring, fan sensors, battery life and cycles, weather, and more. Of course, it also supports Dark Mode. the iStat Menus weather feature gives you a quick view of current weather conditions in the menu bar, or an in-depth look at very detailed hourly forecasts and weekly weather overviews, including temperature, wind speed and direction, rainfall probability, humidity, dew point, UV index, air pressure, visibility, and more. iStat Menus can display weather information based on your current location or almost any city in the world. iStat Menus is able to notify you of a wide range of events based on CPU, GPU, memory, disk, network, sensors, batteries, power and weather, whether it's a change in public IP, a loss of internet connectivity, CPU usage exceeding 60% for more than 10 seconds, or other almost unlimited conditions. It can even notify you of the day's weather or alert you to changes in daylight saving time.

item.title: Vitals 1.9.7
item.description:
macOS Activity Monitor Alternative

Vitals is a system resource monitoring tool for macOS that can be used as an alternative to activity monitors in daily use, combining the statistics of applications and their auxiliary processes to visually present the CPU, memory, energy consumption, disk, and network occupancy of each application, helping to locate sources of stuttering, heating, and power consumption. The software supports custom menu bar readings and charts, saves local history for up to a year, and sends notifications when applications continue to experience high loads, memory growth, or disk and network activity anomalies. For development scenarios, Vitals organizes development servers and ports by project, marks idle services, displays Docker container resource usage, tracks programming agent sessions and their launched subprocesses, and provides information on AI program balance, reset time, and token usage. Built-in MCP services and command-line tools for Claude, Codex, Cursor, or script queries for system status. It also integrates independent application volume, temperature and fan, battery health, Bluetooth device power, GPU and neural network engine monitoring.

item.title: Balance 2.8
item.description:
Focus time tracker and timer

Balance is a time-tracking timer for Mac for study, work and freelancing. It combines focus timing, the Pomodoro technique, break reminders and hour logging so you start and stop tasks deliberately. You can track time per workspace and project, switch between regular timing and focus sessions, and log billable hours. It also provides a work-life balance score, log, month and year views, goals and exportable reports. It integrates with macOS through the menu bar, Spotlight, Shortcuts and Siri, with a clean interface.

item.title: Bear 熊掌记 3.0.4
item.description:
Markdown Writing and Note Taking Tools

BearMaster is an elegant and easy-to-use Markdown writing software designed to help users capture inspiration, write conveniently, and plan to-dos to keep life organized. It is suitable for people from all walks of life, such as writers, lawyers, chefs, CEOs, teachers, doctors, engineers, students and parents, and is extremely easy to use, without the need to register or create an account to get started. Bear Bearmaster supports a variety of text formats, including right-to-left languages such as Arabic, Hebrew, and Farsi, and can easily create notes through Siri and shortcuts, emphasizing privacy and ensuring the privacy of users' notes. It supports a flexible Markdown language that makes text easy to migrate and preserves various Markdown formats. Users can efficiently organize their notes through tags and to-dos, and easily share notes to any third-party app. Bear Bearmaster also offers deep search capabilities, including searching for images and text in PDFs (requires a Bear Pro subscription).

item.title: Eye Monitor 13.1.20
item.description:
Smart break reminder tool

Eye Monitor – Break Reminders, an iOS app that works with macOS apps, has gained traction on platforms like Hacker News, Product Hunt, and sspai.com, and ranks # 1 in health and fitness apps in 13 countries. The app alerts users when their Mac's fatigue reaches a preset threshold and prevents them from indulging in the phone while away from the computer. Its macOS version is a fully automated fatigue monitoring and alerting tool designed to help users rest, relax, and reduce fatigue. Eye Monitor automatically analyzes the user's behavior, such as mouse, trackpad, scroll wheel movement, and keyboard input, to notify the user that the fatigue threshold has been reached. The app can be used as a rest reminder, hydration reminder, stretch reminder, screen time reminder, RSI reminder, etc. to help users maintain eye health and improve sitting-related issues. Eye Monitor is an app designed to help users reduce visual fatigue and stay healthy, and works with macOS versions.

item.title: Anybox 2.15.2
item.description:
Organize bookmarks across devices

Anybox is a cross-platform bookmark management and read later app that seamlessly syncs across iPhone, iPad, and Mac devices to help users easily save and organize web links, notes, and images. Anybox provides a powerful system of nested tags and folders that give users the flexibility to categorize their bookmarks, while enabling the creation of smart lists that automatically categorize content based on attributes such as title, date added, and more. Users can quickly save links via the global system share menu, or import bookmarks directly from within a browser or third-party app. The Anybox built-in keyboard extension allows for quick input of frequently used links and notes; it also supports widget tracking of reading lists or one-click saving of clipboard contents to specified document sets. Anybox uses iCloud sync, does not collect any personal data, and pays attention to user privacy protection. Simple and smooth interface, powerful search function, support for focus search bookmarks, images and files can also be saved and viewed. Anybox is suitable for knowledge workers, researchers, and users who need to organize network resources on a daily basis, greatly improving information management efficiency through intelligent classification and shortcuts, and making bookmark organization orderly and accessible.

item.title: FileBo 1.3.0
item.description:
macOS File Quick Access Tool

FileBo is a quick access tool for recent files that resides in the macOS menu bar, and it pops up a simple window showing the files and folders you recently used, changed, saved, or downloaded, like a smart drawer that fills in automatically, solving everyday problems that files can't find immediately after saving or downloading. Finder excels at a lot of things, but remembering exactly where that file went five minutes ago is not always its strong point, FileBo puts recent files, folders, apps, and connected drives all at the touch of a button, even inside a full-screen app, so you can instantly get back to the document, picture, zip, or project you were working on. It's more focused and practical than Finder's built-in view of recent projects, designed to quickly retrieve what you're working on, and you can decide where you want to track, add unwanted files or folders to your ignore list, and eliminate things you never want to see.

item.title: LanScan 8.2.18
item.description:
Mac LAN Device Scan Tool

LanScan is a simple and efficient network scanning tool that supports IPv4 and IPv6 and is able to discover all active devices within any subnet, including local subnets or any user-configured public subnets. For IPv4, LanScan automatically detects configured interfaces (such as Airport, Ethernet, virtual interfaces, etc.) and supports scanning from a single IP to the entire IPv4 address space. It scans the local network with ARP packets, the public IP network range with Ping, SMB, mDNS packets, and displays the IP address, MAC address, up to four hostnames, and associated vendor information. LanScan can also discover SMB domains (if configured), support hostname resolution for DNS, mDNS (Apple devices) and SMB (Windows devices), allow custom hostname editing and add custom comments for each device, can also open custom URLs in the browser, and support exporting results as CSV files, users can freely hide/display columns, and align columns according to personal preferences, no number of devices found ‘attributes’ associated with the account.

item.title: Highland Pro 3.4.0
item.description:
Professional Film and Television Script Writing

Highland Pro is a professional writing app created by renowned screenwriter and novelist John August, designed for film and television writers, novelists, and all users who need to focus on creating. It uses a clean, clean interface and innovative writing tools to help users focus entirely on story content rather than cumbersome formatting. Highland Pro fully supports Mac, iPad, and iPhone, allowing users to create scripts, screenplays, and novels on the go. The new Lookup feature lets you quickly query definitions, rhymes, or world facts directly in drafts without switching apps; The Shelf lets users store snippets, notes, and creative ideas securely, avoiding the accidental deletion of important conversations. Title Page Builder quickly generates professional title pages that meet industry standards, and Custom Pages supports adding custom pages such as a foreword, cast, or production breakdown. The Overview view provides an overview of the work, highlighting key elements such as characters, scenes, and more; Grammar Highlight enhances the quality of writing by analyzing nouns, verbs, adjectives, and adverbs.

item.title: Barista 1.1.6
item.description:
Mac menu bar component collection

Barista is a multi-functional menu bar component tool for macOS that centralizes more than thirty-five components into a unified interface, including calendar, reminders, weather, clipboard history, stock and cryptocurrency quotes, mail, world clock, calculator, translation, QR code generation, system monitoring, and media control. Users can enable components and freely adjust the order as needed, arrange them directly in the system menu bar, or use keyboard shortcuts to evoke a separate floating bar to avoid frequent window switching. The software supports saving different layouts for laptop screens and external monitors, automatically switches when the connection status changes, and provides a bangshell screen space compression scheme. The built-in mail component supports reading, composing, replying, forwarding, and session string browsing. The clipboard manager supports encrypted storage, search history, automatic exclusion of password managers, and designated applications. Weather takes Apple Weather data and overrides calendar events and reminders integration, note multi-tagging, RSS news, web pop-ups, Spotify and Apple Music playback information, CPU memory battery network monitoring, and stay awake.

item.title: Taska 2.3
item.description:
Native app to efficiently manage Git tasks

Taska (formerly known as Sonar) is a native Mac application that provides users with a fast and lightweight alternative to task management, specifically designed to handle tasks on GitHub or GitLab. Taska can do most of the functions of the GitHub or GitLab web interface, but it's faster and easier to use! Users can enjoy a 14-day, no-strings-attached free trial with no subscription, registration, or any purchase required during the trial period, with the option of an annual subscription plan or one-time purchase at the end of the trial. Taska's native user interface is based on the official APIs of GitHub and GitLab, ensuring the security of user data and 100% compatibility with other team members using or not using Taska. Taska provides powerful editing capabilities that allow you to enter task titles, assignees, and labels in one line; close tasks as easily as checkboxes; edit multiple tasks quickly and intuitively, and multitask from a single window. In addition, important tasks can be pinned to the top for easy and quick access, supporting the full Markdown format.

item.title: Moonlitt 2.10.1
item.description:
Moon Phase Calendar and Moon Location Tracking

Moonlitt is a lunar phase tracking tool for astronomy enthusiasts and everyday lunar viewers that provides complete information around the moon's cycle, visibility, and timing. It can view moon phase changes by date, moonrise and midday time, moon distance and illumination, and can also combine the current position to give the moon's orientation in the sky. The app supports AR view and moon compass to help you locate the moon in a real environment and determine if buildings or terrain are blocking your view. Moonlitt also integrates lunar phase calendars, full moon crescent and eclipse reminders, lunar traditional knowledge, and Chinese moon festival information for photography, observing programs, and cultural exploration. Available on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro, the app comes with widgets, real-time activity, offline capabilities, and an interface optimized for accessibility. Moonlitt is a lunar tracking application that integrates a lunar phase calendar, moon location query, eclipse reminder and observation assistance to meet the needs of daily moon phase viewing, as well as help you plan photography, observation and popular science learning.

item.title: ScreenCam 1.4.1
item.description:
macOS Lightweight Native Screen Recorder

ScreenCam: Screen Studio is a screen recording and post-editing tool for macOS that makes product presentations, software tutorials, course content, and social media videos. It enables the recording of entire screens, single windows, or custom areas, and captures both system audio and microphone sounds, allowing for complete preservation of narrative, operational steps, and interface changes. After recording, users can continue to work on frame composition, zoom animations, cursor styles, background effects, and playback rhythms in the same editor without having to switch to other editing software frequently. The background can be wallpaper, solid color, custom image or video, and the aspect ratio and export effect can also be adjusted according to the publishing platform. ScreenCam: Screen Studio puts more emphasis on the efficiency of finishing, beautifying and presenting after screen recording, helping ordinary operation records quickly become clear, clean and rhythmic video works.

item.title: Jomo 2.0.0
item.description:
Focus Guard and Distraction Shielding Tool

Jomo is a powerful screen time management and focus guard tool for Mac that helps users easily combat digital distractions, permanently or regularly blocks any disruptive website (Safari, Chrome, Arc, Opera, Edge, Brave and other mainstream browsers) and apps (including Mail, Slack, etc.) with a few clicks. It provides a timed break function that allows users to consciously use restricted content for a short time, flexible scheduling, etc. At present, the workday automatic cycle blocking, the template quickly builds a personalized focus system, and at the same time has a minimalist permission to design a safe and accurate system without slowing down the performance, upgrade the Jomo Plus subscription ($5.99 per month, $29.99 per year equivalent to $2.49 per month or one-time 99. $99 Lifetime Purchase) Unlock unlimited repetitive schedules, hard to bypass strict modes, and companion iPhone and iPad versions to help improve focus, practice digital minimalism, improve sleep quality, develop healthy habits, say goodbye to procrastination and impulsive consumption, and even break addictive behaviors such as porn gambling, easily saving more than 2 hours a day, regaining deep work and a more meaningful rhythm of life...

item.title: Reeder. 2026.11.2
item.description:
RSS Subscription Management Tool

Reeder is an all-in-one inbox app for reading, watching, and listening to content from a variety of sources. It lets you bid farewell to the annoyance of unread counts and allows you to continue your last reading on any device by syncing timeline positions across devices. Reeder also allows users to convert any tag into a public, automatically updated feed, supports JSON format, can be viewed in any browser or added to any JSON-enabled RSS reader, and simplifies the content sharing process. More than just an RSS feed, Reeder integrates videos, podcasts, and social media posts to provide a unified timeline view that, while not intended to replace the full-featured client, provides a centralized way to track what you're following and opens content in other apps when you need insight. Reeder also has the ability to save and organize links, allowing users to easily save links from Safari or any other app by sharing extensions, keeping content organized and easy to find.

item.title: Transcrybe 3.2.2
item.description:
Mac Real-Time Subtitle Translation Tool

Transcrybe is a real-time subtitle translation tool for macOS that monitors microphones, select apps, or system-wide app audio and instantly converts voice from meetings, videos, podcasts, live streams, and presentations into on-screen subtitles. It is suitable for teleconferencing, YouTube content learning, cross-language phone communication, and real-time media understanding, such as Zoom, without requiring the other party to install a robot or plug-in. The software emphasizes native processing, the audio remains on the Mac, no recording is uploaded, and the wait caused by the delay in the cloud is reduced. Users can select the original speech language and one or more target subtitle languages, display parallel translations at the same time, and adjust the subtitle font size, color, position, and scrolling style according to the screen environment to make the subtitle overlay more suitable for different workflows and viewing scenarios. Transcrybe is a real-time subtitle translation app running on a Mac that captures speech from a microphone, a single app, or all app audio and instantly displays translated subtitles on the screen for online meetings, video learning, podcast listening, live viewing, and cross-language communication, with privacy, native processing speed, and subtitle readability.

item.title: Promta 1.3.0
item.description:
Centralized management of AI prompt words

Promta is an AI prompt management and collection tool for macOS, iPhone, and iPad users, suitable for people who often use AI services such as ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. It preserves high-quality prompt words scattered across chat logs, documents, and memos, forming a searchable, categorizable, and reusable vocabulary of personal prompts. Users can organize prompts for different scenarios through tags, folders, and favorites, such as writing, marketing, programming, learning research, or daily office, and quickly retrieve instructions that have been polished with a full library search. Promta supports variables and templates, so that common prompts can be quickly replaced by different tasks, and copied into mainstream AI tools with one click. It also provides multi-device sync, team sharing, version management, AI optimization, dark mode, and custom themes to help creators, developers, students, and productivity tool users reduce repetitive typing and keep prompt assets organized over time.

item.title: ClickClack 5.4.0
item.description:
macOS Typing Exercise Tool

ClickClack is a minimalist and interference-free typing speed test and practice application designed to improve typing skills. It provides two speed test modes, timing and counting, structured grading courses (covering home key, top row, bottom row, symbols and numeric keys) paired with progress tracking and high score recording. The native AI text generator integrated with macOS 26 and Apple Intelligence can infinitely produce multilingual high-quality practice articles and provide typing. Insight analysis (Pro version unlocks deeper accuracy and consistency assessment), all AI functions run locally and zero data collection ensures privacy;

item.title: BetterMacWidgets 2.12.0
item.description:
macOS High Face Desktop Widget

BetterMacWidgets is a desktop widget tool for macOS 15 and above running on Apple Silicon Mac that places weather, music playback, system status, to-dos, notes, clocks, world time, calendars, photos, cryptocurrencies, web traffic, Bluetooth devices, app launchers, shortcuts, timers, stopwatches, unit converters, and password generators directly on the desktop. The software provides 25 widgets and 20 themes, supports free drag and drop and invisible snap meshes, so that widgets of different sizes are neatly arranged; weather supports real-time forecasting and custom cities, music widgets can connect Spotify or Apple Music and playback control, and photo widgets can read specific folders and play dynamic slides. The liquid glass exterior supports transparent suspension and adjustable frosting, and the Pro version also offers the same size widget stacking, desktop layout configuration, cross-monitor adaptation, and automatic switching by time, front-end application, or connected display.

item.title: ComfortFiles 1.18.0
item.description:
Windows-style file manager

ComfortFiles is a native file manager for macOS 13 Ventura and later that combines the operating habits of Windows Explorer with the Mac system experience for users who are switching from Windows to Mac and want to stay familiar with file management. The software provides an expandable folder tree, a breadcrumb address bar that supports input paths, a multi-tabbed and sortable detailed list, and keeps folders on top of different sorting methods. The user can cut and paste the file through Command X and Command V, use enter to open the project, F2 to rename, or drag the file to the sidebar directory or other tabs to finish organizing, and undo or redo it after an error. It supports direct browsing of zip, RAR, and 7z compressed packages, preview of internal content, and editing of zip without requiring full unzip. Built-in storage analytics can look at the space occupied layer by layer, explain large projects and system data, and indicate whether it is suitable for removal;

item.title: Spencer 1.8.0
item.description:
macOS Professional Workspace Window Manager

Spencer is a professional window manager designed to help users organize the workspace of their Mac desktop, making it easy for users to save and restore the layout of all open windows. With one-click operation, Spencer is able to restore the window position after reboot, supporting multiple virtual desktop and multi-monitor configurations, enabling users to create profiles suitable for different tasks and quickly switch between them. Whether working, meeting, or relaxing, Spencer ensures that the user's application is not accidentally closed, and the window size and position can be adjusted according to the layout of the storage, allowing the user to arrange the window freely in any size and position. At the same time, Spencer is Apple notarized, which ensures safe and reliable use, and supports macOS 13 Ventura and above. Users also get a 14-day money-back guarantee and can try the app to be more productive. Spencer is a professional window management tool designed to help Mac users organize their desktop workspace and easily save and restore window layouts. Spencer makes it easy to duplicate desktop settings by saving and restoring all open window positions with one click.

item.title: TelunKey 2.1.14
item.description:
Mac Window Switcher

TelunKey is a native macOS keyboard window switching tool developed with Swift that integrates application activation and target window selection into a single keystroke operation for work scenarios that frequently switch between multiple applications, windows, and desktops. The software supports independent triggering of left and right Command and left and right Option, and can also be triggered using Space, which is convenient to configure the operation according to personal habits. After triggering, the actionable target is directly displayed, and the window keyboard layout is mapped to the key position area. The user can confirm the target by pressing the key, reducing the repeated switching between the application and the mouse to find the window. Especially suitable for Chrome multi-window browsing and the scene where a large number of windows work in parallel. TelunKey focuses on low latency response and lightweight background operation, reducing double counting and invalid wake-up by updating window information on demand and lightweight cache. Core data remains on-premises, with no behavioral analysis by default, and no reliance on cloud services. The software supports at least macOS 14.0 Sonoma, which can be installed and updated through Homebrew, and in-app check for updates;

item.title: Tuck Pro 1.4.10
item.description:
Hide menu bar icons on Mac

Tuck is a native menu bar organizer for macOS 14 to 27 that tidies up the growing pile of app and system icons. In Push mode, one click hides the menu bar icons to the left of Tuck and another click restores them; on notched MacBooks, hidden items appear in a Shelf panel below the menu bar. You can drag icons to reorder them, set each to always show, always hide or follow the main toggle, and control it with shortcuts. Pro adds auto-hide, show-on-hover, per-app visibility rules and Shelf customization. It is under 10 MB with no telemetry; the free version has no time limit and Pro is a one-time license for up to three Macs.

item.title: TabTab 2.2.4
item.description:
Quickly switch between windows and tabs

TabTab is a powerful window and tab management tool designed for Mac to increase user productivity. It supports Intel and Apple Silicon Macs and is compatible with macOS 14.0 and above, providing a fast and intuitive experience that runs entirely on your device. TabTab not only manages windows in all Mac apps, but also supports full-screen and split-screen views, allowing you to manage tabs within specific apps like Google Chrome, Safari, Visual Studio Code, and more. TabTab It also has a powerful search feature that allows users to search by app name, window title, and tab title. Rated highly by users for its beautiful packaging, compact local design, optimized hotkeys, and lightning-fast performance, TabTab is considered an indispensable productivity tool on the Mac. Early adopters lauded this as a way for Apple to navigate its tags, praising its smooth, visually pleasing interface and positive response from developers.

item.title: Ganella 1.0.3
item.description:
macOS Program Dock Dock Widget Tool

Ganella is a native Dock tool for macOS 14 Sonoma and later that combines app launch, folder access, and live widgets in one dock. It imports pinned apps and folders from the system Dock, preserves common features like trash bins, notification icons, icon enlargement and auto-hiding, and lets supported app interactive widgets present information about music playback, calendar scheduling, browser tabs, notes, and development and AI tools. The software is compatible with Spotify, Music, Safari, Chrome, Xcode, Terminal, ChatGPT, Codex, Claude and other applications. Other applications are still displayed with plain icons. The built-in clipboard history makes it easy to access the copied content again, and the volume and device change prompts help to keep up with the status; multi-monitor users can set the edge of the Dock for each screen separately. The interface offers four styles with custom accent colors, where Liquid Glass requires macOS 26.

item.title: Tuna 0.110
item.description:
macOS Native Modernization Launcher

Tuna is a new modern launcher for macOS, redesigned based on the classic interactive concept of Quicksilver and built from the ground up using native Swift, with an emphasis on speed, keyboard drives, and a stereotyped operating experience. It is suitable for macOS 15 Sequoia or update system. It provides a variety of input and execution methods such as Fuzzy Mode, Combo Mode, Text Mode and Talk Mode. Users can quickly locate applications, files or actions through fuzzy search, and can also complete more complex workflows with combined instructions. Tuna supports extension mechanisms and plans to introduce third-party extension capabilities that will allow the launcher to be used not only to open applications, but also to gradually assume the role of an entry point for automation, text processing, command triggering, and day-to-day efficiency. The overall interface is modern macOS style, suitable for Mac users who want to use the keyboard to reduce mouse operation, improve system navigation efficiency, and find the spiritual successor of Quicksilver.

item.title: Substage 1.2.3
item.description:
AI Enhanced Finder File Actions

Substage is an app that makes it easy to manage your Mac by streamlining workflows through natural language processing, transforming your instructions into powerful Terminal commands without the hassle of complex syntax. Whether it's file conversion, image editing, or document processing, Substage does it quickly and efficiently. By simply entering the request in natural language, Substage can accurately generate the corresponding Terminal command, saving time and effort in managing files and system operations. You can quickly convert images, videos, and more with simple commands like “Convert to JPG” or “Convert this MOV file to 1080p MP4” without opening another app. In addition, Substage supports control system settings, such as switching dark mode, keeping your Mac from going to sleep, or querying hardware information, to easily respond to various needs. Users can also ask questions directly, such as “How many centimeters is 5 feet?” ”or“ Who is the author of this PDF? ”and a quick and accurate answer.

item.title: ByteMail 1.9.18
item.description:
AI-enhanced native Mac email client

bytemail is a native Mac email client built with SwiftUI and AppKit, with no bundled browser engine. It supports Gmail, iCloud, Outlook, Microsoft 365, Yahoo, Fastmail and other IMAP accounts in one fast unified inbox. Features include conversation and classic views, instant cross-account and attachment search, smart labels, rule-based archiving, snooze, scheduled send, undo send, reminders and per-account signatures. It connects directly to your mail provider, keeps credentials in the macOS Keychain, and sends no mail, contacts or usage data through bytemail servers. Tracking pixels and tracking link parameters are stripped, and it flags spoofed domains and suspicious links. It also offers local summaries, smart replies and Rewrite, and connects to AI apps such as Claude, Codex and Cursor through MCP.

item.title: Vidnip 2.0.6
item.description:
macOS Web Video Sniffer Downloader

Vidnip is a video download and media management software for Apple Silicon Mac that supports macOS 14 and above, combining web video detection, download, format conversion, and local playback in one app. After pasting the page link, the software can identify MP4, WebM, HLS/m3u8 and dash videos through traffic monitoring. Combined with the yt-dlp engine, it covers more than 1800 sites, automatically downloads segments in parallel and merges them into a playable MP4, supporting image quality selection, breakpoint continuation, batch link processing and channel update subscription. The built-in video library organizes content by source, filters unwatched items and remembers playback progress; The music library supports audio extraction, album and artist browsing, tag management, and scrolling lyrics. The subtitle feature supports downloading site subtitles, exporting text, and generating subtitles or lyrics using native speech recognition on macOS 26 and above. With the iPhone app, you can also sync music, transfer videos, play back, and remotely send download links.

item.title: Mote 1.6.0
item.description:
macOS Hover Markdown Editor

Mote is a native floating Markdown workbench for macOS that opens a lightweight window above all apps with shortcuts to quickly take ideas, edit notes, run terminal commands, organize web materials, and work on meeting content. It supports WYSIWYG Markdown rendering, with titles, bold, code, checkboxes, and math expressions rendered directly as you type, and offers Vim mode, plain Markdown pasting, and a variety of themes. Mote also integrates YouTube learning notes, microphone and system audio local transcription, speaker tags, Obsidian library reading and writing, web scribbling, clipboard collection, regular review, and AI agent collaboration such as Claude Code. Both notes and transcriptions can be saved locally on the Mac, and the file remains in a user-controlled Markdown format, independent of the cloud, account, or conference robot. Built with Swift and AppKit for macOS 15 and above, the software starts up quickly, takes up less resources, and is suitable for users who need to quickly switch between reading, conferencing, writing, and development.

item.title: SnappyNotes 2.1.0
item.description:
Markdown Sidebar Notepad

SnappyNotes is a modern side notebook app designed for efficient note-taking. It can be opened at any time on the edge of your screen, allowing users to quickly record ideas at work without switching apps or interrupting focus. SnappyNotes with Markdown support allows users to format notes in real time and provides a full-screen focus mode to eliminate distractions and ensure a smooth writing process. SnappyNotes also offers powerful features like autosave, seamless cloud sync, and one-click PDF export for users looking to boost their productivity. SnappyNotes Mac is a modern side notebook app designed to help users take quick notes at work without switching between apps or breaking focus. With its elegant design and powerful features, it is an ideal tool for increased productivity. Instant access: SnappyNotes always resides on the side of the screen, and users can open it with simple gestures to quickly record information and ensure that work is not interrupted.
